data.description: Investor Deal | 1 Bed + Study | Damac Lagoons View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this stunning 1-bedroom + study apartment located in Golf Gate 2, one of the most exciting new developments in DAMAC Hills. Offering a perfect blend of contemporary design, beautiful community views towards Damac Lagoons, and resort-style amenities, this unit is ideal for both end-users and investors.

Unit Highlights:

Bedroom + Study Room

⦁ Size: 642.60 sq. ft
⦁ 10th Floor
⦁ Spacious Balcony with community views overlooking Damac Lagoons
⦁ Modern, open-plan layout with a stylish fitted kitchen
⦁ Built-in wardrobes for smart storage
⦁ Handover: Q4 2026 — perfect for future planning or investment

Golf Gate 2 Facilities & Community Features:

⦁ Fully equipped fitness center
⦁ Three resort-style swimming pools with cascading waterfall feature
⦁ High-speed elevators and covered parking
⦁ 24/7 security for peace of mind
⦁ Adjacent to Trump International Golf Club
⦁ Access to Malibu Bay wave pool
⦁ Beautifully landscaped parks, jogging trails, kids’ play zones, and retail outlets

Prime Connectivity:

⦁ 20 minutes to Mall of the Emirates
⦁ 25 minutes to Downtown Dubai
⦁ Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Hessa Street, connecting you to all major parts of Dubai.
